title: Video Editing & Post-Production
description: Transforming your footage with clean edits, balanced color, clear sound, and titles for your website and social media.
seoTitle: Video Editing & Post-Production Services | Cambridge & London | FilmEditRun
seoDescription: Professional video editing, color balancing, and audio cleanup for business, event, and promotional videos. Fast turnaround across Cambridge and London.
heroHeading: *Great footage* is only half the battle. The rest happens in the *edit*.
heroLead: A great edit doesn’t just cut out the pauses; it builds momentum. From the moment our crews capture your interviews, live event, or brand story on location, we’re already shaping how it all comes together. By layering dynamic B-roll, custom motion graphics, and rich sound design, we turn raw footage (whether filmed by us or supplied by your team) into polished videos that look and sound brilliant across your website, keynotes, and social feeds.
breakdownHeading: Where the shoot comes to life.
breakdownBody: Every project has a pulse. The edit is where we take the energy of the day (the key insights from an interview, the atmosphere in the venue, the unscripted moments) and shape it into a story that actually connects. By pairing on-camera voices with dynamic B-roll, clean animated graphics, and thoughtful sound design, we make sure your message isn’t just seen, but understood and remembered.

deliverables.title: Narrative Flow & B-Roll
deliverables.description: We find the thread that holds your story together. By weaving your primary dialogue with purposeful B-roll and cutaways, we create a rich, visual rhythm that keeps viewers engaged from the first second to the final frame.

deliverables.title: Motion Graphics & Animated Titles
deliverables.description: Graphics should clarify, not distract. We build clean animated titles, lower-thirds, and visual callouts that support your story, emphasize key takeaways, and match your brand guidelines with precision.

deliverables.title: Sound Design & Multi-Format Delivery
deliverables.description: Audio is half the experience. We clear out background noise, level dialogue so every voice is crisp, and mix music that drives the pace, delivering polished master films alongside vertical cutdowns and captions ready for social feeds.

ctaHeading: Have a story you want to tell?
ctaDescription: Whether you're planning an upcoming shoot with our team or have raw footage you'd like to bring to life, let’s talk through your ideas and timeline.
